purpose: Test history-based correspondence with occlusion uncertainty before changing PIDG shape training
model_scope: Image-plane probabilistic tracking module, not a new trained Gaussian reconstruction or a 3D dynamics solver
time: (original_frame_id-1)/199, retaining irregular training intervals; image position in 400x225 pixels
data: 120 existing training RGBA frames and conservative visible-only FB tracks from the completed surface-support audit; no new heldout image evaluation
synthetic_tests: Known identity passing, symmetric identity ambiguity after hidden interaction, irregular time, covariance growth, outliers, merge rejection and flags-off

real_controlled_test.source: First25 training frames through original42, before observed component merges
real_controlled_test.reference: Independent frozen visible-only FB partial labels; qualify component purity>=0.95 and >=30 supported pixels; pseudo-reference, not physical identity GT
metrics: accepted ID correspondence accuracy versus pseudo-reference
real_controlled_test.no_reference_leak: Tracker sees only remaining component observations, not pseudo-reference labels or hidden RGB/flow observations

natural_test: All120 training frames, explicitly retain ambiguity across merge/split intervals; no physical ID accuracy claim without GT
integration_gate: Require passing synthetic ambiguity tests and lower controlled forecast error without increased false accepted ID matches; full-sequence surface-support gate remains required separately
budget: One bounded correspondence prototype and controlled evaluations; optional read-only GPU compositor check, zero Gaussian optimizer steps

correctness_revision.change: Guarded mode latches unresolved seed identities after plausible rival matches or merged support; smooth later motion alone cannot clear this state. Position proposals continue, accepted identity stays unknown. No independent re-identification cue is available in this prototype.
correctness_revision.test: Identical hidden-pass/hidden-bounce observations through8 extra reappearance frames and checkpoint restore
